authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4219 guvāka explicitly gives Assamese guwā areca/betelnut and Oriya/Bhojpuri guā its nut. The selected eastern gua/gua̯ betelnut responses fit this family with the source syllabicity marking retained. The nut is the areca seed used with betel, not the betel leaf; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: gua̯.
